term: separate modal worlds and temporal histories with explicit now-slice coherence
definition: History supplies an existing Kant Ontic, an independently assigned IsAt : World → Being → Time → Prop, and a designated now : Time. CoherentAtNow is the separate proposition that Ontic.ExistsAt w x is equivalent to IsAt w x now for all worlds and candidates. It is not a proof field of History. This interprets modal presence at a selected time; it does not redefine presence as existence at some time in a history. Ontic.Causes and the old profile grounds relation remain world-relative primitives, not temporal successor relations.
note: Tiny analyst history extension reusing existing Ontic semantics. World, Being and Time are separate parameters; controls use Bool worlds, old candidate types and Int times with now=0. Explicit coherence is included in each closed control. No global cause/ground bridge, time-indexed causal law or metaphysical possibility follows. Reading of IsAt for the modal spine (attempt c94eed5b, PR #1493): inclusive, actual in the history and bearing on the moment, by location at it (a temporal thing) or co-presence to it (a non-temporal agent); the same reading serves A1-A3, A2ab and SustainingCausation. Effect on A2 (inert emptiness): a concrete-empty moment also lacks co-present concrete beings, so its antecedent is rarer and its consequent harder to meet (not an order by strength), and Arrival A's necessary concrete individual may be non-temporal. A1 (presence implies existence in the history) accepts the reading; A3 is unaffected.
